name: Mizushima Asa
source:
Sophomore at East School. Swimming team member. She is from this town, but used to go to a school in a neighboring city. She just transferred to East School this semester.

She has a rough and girly personality. However, she is actually shy, and is blunt and brusque with people she meets for the first time. Because of this, she has a hard time fitting in with her surroundings.

[From [url=http://www.sp-janis.com/ciel/soranoiromizunoiro/]official site[/url]]
